title: Linkability of User Activities Over Time
description: GPS traces and timestamps in sensor batches allow linking user movements and activities across different sessions, enabling tracking of behavior patterns.
assumptions: Data is transmitted without anonymization or aggregation.

title: Direct Identification via Device ID
description: Transmission of unique device ID enables direct identification of the user, especially if combined with other data.
assumptions: Device ID is unique and not pseudonymized.

title: Eavesdropping on Data in Transit
description: Unencrypted transmission of sensor data (GPS, exercise sessions) allows interception by attackers during sync.
assumptions: No encryption or weak encryption is used for data transfer.

title: Insecure Data Storage at Destination
description: Companion app may store synced sensor data insecurely, risking unauthorized access or leaks.
assumptions: App lacks proper data protection measures (e.g., encryption at rest).

title: Lack of User Awareness About Data Collection
description: Users may not be informed that their sensor data (GPS, exercise sessions) is being synced to the app.
assumptions: Privacy policy or consent mechanisms are unclear or absent.

title: Non-Compliance with Data Protection Laws
description: App may process personal data (GPS, device ID) without adhering to regulations like GDPR or CCPA.
assumptions: Data handling practices lack legal compliance checks.
